notes: The `8<` file-list/file concatenation in single-file `-verilog` is the deliberate, in-tree-tested design of the unified ExportVerilog emitter (a debug/convenience "all files in one stream" view), with `-split-verilog` as the intended production path; the maintainer explicitly stated `-verilog` "will not in general produce valid verilog" and is only for compiler test cases. The exact `firrtl_black_box_resource_files.f` mechanism reported no longer exists at this release (clean Verilog is emitted for blackbox designs). Whether/how to change the intended behavior (filter `.f` files vs. hide/deprecate `--verilog` vs. status quo) is an unsettled design decision, not a defect.
cost_provenance: cost_usd is OpenCode-reported session cost, not an AWS invoice amount
